def: properly, to whisper, i.e. (by implication) to utter as aoracle

occurrences.text: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
